title: fix(plugin-form): the record edit dialog draws a record the caller may read but not write as read-only, says why, and offers no Save
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8DBY9GiYPjaHy3dgnowAq6D)_
Fixes #27138

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:记录编辑对话框读取服务端对“这一行”的 `writable` 判决与审批锁;不可写的行整表只读、说明原因、不显示保存。
- 为什么改:只读共享或审批锁定的记录,对话框仍可编辑,填完点保存被服务端整单拒绝。
- 风险与回滚:仅在 `writable: false` 或审批锁时收紧;缺 `writable` 的旧服务端行为不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/permissions/src/RecordFieldAccessScope.tsx`(`refusedRow`)、`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/fieldWriteGate.ts`(`closedFormAffordance`)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`(`formApprovals`)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/recordFieldAccess.rowWritable-27138.test.tsx`,预期 10 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The record edit surfaces now ask the server whether THIS row is writable, and read the approvals record lock the projection leaves out. No client-side re-derivation of sharing (ruling 6457467702, letter B).

- **Type.** `RecordFieldAccess` (`@object-ui/types`) gains `writable?: boolean`, the record projection's row verdict (spec `GetRecordFieldAccessResponseSchema`, landed by PR #27232). `ObjectStackAdapter.getRecordFieldAccess` already returns the client's answer untouched, so the adapter is unchanged.
- **Scope.** `RecordFieldAccessScope` (`@object-ui/permissions`): on `writable: false`, `refusedRow` answers `write` refused on every field of the record and `check(object, 'update')` refused with the reason `record-not-writable`. `read`, `create`, other objects and a `check` naming another record keep the enclosing answer; an object grant the provider already refuses keeps its own reason. A new `lockedBy: 'approval'` prop answers the same way with `record-locked-by-approval`, before any answer and on a data source without the projection. `writable: true` or an absent key changes nothing. A scope nested under one for the same record adds a host lock without asking again.
- **Form.** Every gate below the scope reads it with no call-site change: `gateFormFields` (field locks plus the form-wide lock), the outbound `fieldWriteGate`, and the detail page's inline edit (`RecordFieldAccessForRecord`). `closedFormAffordance` reports `record` / `approval` for such a row, read off the scoped `check`'s reason. `ClosedAffordanceNotice` says "You don't have permission to edit this record. The fields are read-only." (new key `form.noPermissionToEditRecord`, all ten packs) or the record page's approval sentence (`detail.lockedTooltip`, reused). `ModalForm` and `DrawerForm` offer no Save on it (`closedForRecord`). `ModalForm` takes `lockedBy` as a React prop, and `RecordFieldAccessForForm` forwards it.
- **Approval lock in the console's edit dialog.** `AppContent` reads the approvals state of the record the overlay edits with `useRecordApprovals` (the record page's read, joined on the wire when the page already asked) and the page's rule. The rule's input is now one helper, `openApprovalOf`, used by both `RecordDetailView` and `AppContent`, so the dialog cannot offer an edit the page locks. The record page's Edit action already read the lock (disabled while approval-locked) and is unchanged.
- `ObjectForm.tsx` is untouched (serial constraint with #27269 / #27159).

## Why

On a `public_read` row the caller may read but not write, the edit dialog drew every field live and the server refused the save whole. That breaks "a client never advertises an edit the gate refuses" (`permission.zod.ts`). Seat note 6468378207: `writable` does not cover the approvals record lock, so a row under approval must read that lock too.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/permissions/src/__tests__/RecordFieldAccessScope.rowWritable-27138.test.tsx` (7 tests).
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/recordFieldAccess.rowWritable-27138.test.tsx` (10 tests, `ModalForm` and `DrawerForm`): `writable: false` gives read-only fields, the record notice and no Save. CONTROL `writable: true` and CONTROL no key keep the fields live and Save offered. An object grant refusal keeps the object notice. The dialog under `lockedBy: 'approval'` (writable row, and a data source without the projection) is read-only with the lock sentence and no Save.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-blocks.rowWritable-27138.test.tsx` (4 tests): `record:details` / `record:highlights` offer no in-place editor on `writable: false`; CONTROL writable.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.editDialogApprovalLock-27138.test.tsx`: a real `AppContent` mount hands `ModalForm` `lockedBy: 'approval'` for a reader outside the slate (record lock answers) and for a participant on a locking node. It hands nothing for a `lockRecord: false` node, nothing when no approval runs, and nothing (with no approvals read) on a create dialog.

## Acceptance notes

- The record page's Edit button still opens the dialog on a `writable: false` row; the dialog explains and offers no Save. Disabling the button itself would need the page host to fetch the projection, which no block above it does today.
- The master-detail arm (`subforms`) of `ModalForm` / `DrawerForm` draws its Save bar through `ObjectForm` / `MasterDetailForm`, which this PR does not touch: its fields lock, its own Save bar stays.
- `DrawerForm` reads `writable` but takes no host approval lock: no host renders it with a known lock today.
- `content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx` already states the `writable` contract ("a client need not offer the edit at all"); it is outside the claimed file surface and unchanged.

## Verification

All readings on head `695f5164` (main merged at `5b5cff15`).

- New tests: scope 7/7, dialog and drawer 10/10, inline edit 4/4, `AppContent` approval lock 5/5.
- Affected suites (lock run, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/permissions/ packages/plugin-form/ packages/i18n/ packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/ packages/app-shell/src/console/ packages/app-shell/src/hooks/`): 705/710 files green on the first run. The 5 red files were older `AppContent` edit-dialog tests whose dialog now issues the approvals read with no fetch double (the network-escape guard). Each now installs one file-wide approvals double; `AppContent` re-run 36/36 files, 266/266 tests. `RecordDetailView` (the `openApprovalOf` refactor) 77/77 files, 512/512 tests.
- Type-check: `@object-ui/types`, `permissions`, `i18n`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-detail` and `app-shell` `type-check` exit 0 after the closure builds.
- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 34 families, all exit 0 (`check-sdui-manifest` included); `--ran` reconciliation: 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` timed out twice (15 s) while the suite above held the box; re-run alone under the lock it was 174/174 files green. `check:type-check-debt` exit 3 (lock queue) on the first pass; it ran under the lock and reported OK.

<details><summary>Ablations (one-shot, restored; blob == HEAD after each)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` against `RecordFieldAccessScope.tsx` / `ModalForm.tsx`, tests resolved from `src` through the `ui/vitest.config.mts` alias, so no dist leg:

- the `writable` read (`answer?.writable === false` to a constant `false`): 6 red, exactly the `writable: false` cases (scope 2, dialog/drawer 2, inline edit 2); the CONTROL cases and the approval cases stay green.
- the host lock (`lockedBy === 'approval'` to a constant `false`): 4 red (scope 2, dialog 2).
- the Save hiding (`!closedForRecord(closedAffordance)` to `true` in `ModalForm`): 3 red.

An earlier attempt at the first one was a refused no-op: the replacement was a substring of the anchor, the tool refused it, and nothing ran.
</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is the repo-wide run CI owns (`Lint UI`, `Lint & Repo Gates`).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
